question: Of the following sites of Harappan Civilization, which one is NOT located in Pakistan?
solution:
The correct answer is __Shortughai.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shortughai **is located in** Afghanistan.**

 
 
• Harappans procured materials for craft production from various places.
 
• From Shortughai, in far off Afghanistan, lapis lazuli which was a bluestone was procured.
